title: NEET Physics
summary: NEET Physics past questions from 8 papers, 2021 to 2026 (the 2024 and 2026 retests included), five a day. Questions NTA asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across papers: NEET 2021-2026 and the Re-NEET retests of 2024 and 2026, each its own sitting. Older questions from the chapters NMC dropped in 2024 are left out (lib/homework/neetSyllabus.ts); questions NTA dropped or made a bonus are left out. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_NEET.md) and checked in the main session.

excludedQuestions.reason: NTA made Re-NEET 2026 Q.26 a bonus: the vernier reading matches none of the printed options
